title: DeathLine
description: Fun Minecraft server that lets you have 12 hours to prepare for the real challenge, which is Hardcore mode, meaning, that once you now die, you are banned forever! We have cool features, giving our player a cool experience!
body:
### DeathLine
DeathLine is a Minecraft server, where you get 12 real-time hours to prepare yourself for the real challenge: Hardcore Mode!

Hardcore Mode means that if you die now, you will get banned from the server!

We offer Cool Features to make the Experience on DeathLine fun:
**/settings** - In Settings, you can toggle items such as the Scoreboard, Bossbar and Chat!
**Backpacks** - An extremely cool feature letting you have backpacks, they help keeping an organized Inventory! **Bounties** - Set Bounties on your enemies with any minecraft item! **Land Claims** - Even though this goes against most of DeathLine's rules, we have added a Land Claim System with *Beacons*! We have lowered nether star drop rates by 90%, so its hard to get your protection, these protection beacons have to be filled with valuables for them to work or else players can destroy the beacon and grief all your builds! **Lobby** - We have added a *Welcoming Lobby* to the server!

There are more features to come.....

 **IP: deathline.mc.printiacs.nl** 
 
 **Discord: [Discord](https://discord.gg/UZzttzqnWB)** 
 
 **Website: [Website](https://sites.google.com/view/deathline/home)**



*Join our Community, and join DeathLine to see how long you can last!*
